chunks.title: Generic Python Backend Dockerfile
chunks.content:
Generic Python Backend Dockerfile

Simple fallback Dockerfile for a Python backend service when no specialized framework (FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit) is detected. Base: python:3.11-slim. Installs pip requirements, copies source. Sets PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1. CMD: sh -c python main.py.

Decision rules:
- Use when language=python, framework=generic, project_type=backend_service
- Fall back to this template only when no framework-specific Dockerfile exists

Trade-offs:
- Assumes main.py as entrypoint — must be updated if the entrypoint differs
- No multi-stage build and no non-root user — extend for production hardening

Anti-patterns:
- Do not use python:latest — always pin to a specific version (e.g. python:3.11-slim)
- Do not copy source before installing requirements — always install deps first
